title: Extract Day of Week from Order Dates
learning_objective: Learn how to convert an order date into a weekday number.

tutorial.explanation: Pivot-by-weekday problems need a way to classify each date. In DuckDB, EXTRACT(DOW FROM date) returns 0 for Sunday, 1 for Monday, and so on.
tutorial.syntax: SELECT order_id, EXTRACT(DOW FROM CAST(order_date AS DATE)) AS dow FROM orders;
tutorial.mental_model: Date extraction turns a date into a grouping or CASE value.

guided_example.prompt: Return each order with its day-of-week number.
guided_example.solution_query: SELECT order_id, EXTRACT(DOW FROM CAST(order_date AS DATE)) AS dow FROM orders;
guided_example.explanation: Casting text to DATE lets EXTRACT read the weekday.

practice.prompt: Return order_id for orders placed on Monday.
practice.expected_query: SELECT order_id FROM orders WHERE EXTRACT(DOW FROM CAST(order_date AS DATE)) = 1;
